title: DeepSeek dsh-superagent — Proactive Coding Agent Harness 研究原型
resourceType: DeepSeek Harness bundle / proactive coding agent research prototype
purpose: 監聽單一 GitHub Repository 的事件與選用 Feishu 訊息，透過 Source → Trigger → Eval → Ticket → Assignment → Executor Session → Report 將授權工作交由獨立 Agent Session 執行並回覆原對話。
recommendation: 適合研究 AI Agent Workspace、AI 軟體開發協作、Agent Harness、工作派發與授權邊界；重點參考事件評估、Mandate、獨立 Worker、持久化副作用佇列、重試與人工注意力最小化。

architecture.flow: Source → Trigger → Eval → Ticket/Mandate → Assignment → Executor Session → Report/Channel
components: Engine as sole writer of Triggers, Threads, Decisions, Tickets and Assignments
DshExecutor with per-Ticket Session and directory
Durable Effects queue and Outbox for side effects after transaction commit
GitHub Source plugin; optional Feishu Source plugin
Web panel prioritizes items needing human attention
principles: Act only on direct authorized requests or written proactive rules
Start unapproved proactive work in observation mode
Report only decisions, useful results and blockers
One concrete question at a time
Honest status reporting and no bypass of limits

caveats: Upstream explicitly labels the repository a research prototype, not an official DeepSeek product or production-ready implementation.
Published code differs from internal implementation and the accompanying design article; some future directions are not implemented.
Designed for one GitHub repository and DeepSeek Harness; not a generic drop-in multi-repository service.
Source includes two environment-specific SKILL.md files; these are not general-purpose standalone coding agents.
No code installed or executed, no end-to-end behavior independently verified.
